title: Wild Smoked Norwegian Salt Cod Pate
description: A peppery and silky Norwegian dish featuring salt cod, perfect for special occasions, this dairy-free friendly pate is a show-off appetizer.
instructions: Soak the salt cod in cold water for 24 hours, changing the water several times.
Drain and flake the cod into a bowl.
Add the smoked paprika, black peppercorns, parsley, dill, lemon juice, and garlic to the bowl.
Mix the ingredients together until well combined.
With a hand mixer or food processor, mix the cod mixture until it becomes smooth and silky.
With the mixer or processor still running, slowly pour in the olive oil.
Continue mixing until the pate is smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover and refrigerate the pate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the pate chilled, garnished with additional parsley and dill if desired.
